01 / FULL-STACK WEB

Dream Ceylon CRM

A CRM for an inbound tourism business, designed around the day-to-day work of planning tours and preparing client documents.

The need

Destinations, itineraries, quotations and customer communication were spread across separate tools.

What I built

A MERN application with JWT-based admin authentication, destination management, itinerary tools, dashboard reporting and branded quotation, invoice and receipt PDFs. It also includes AI-assisted itinerary and reply features.

What I learned: Bringing an end-to-end business workflow into one interface, from data entry to client-ready documents.

ReactNode.jsExpressMongoDBJWT

02 / JAVA BACKEND

Gym Management System

An admin-focused system for handling members, attendance, payments and access records.

The need

Staff need reliable records and clear visibility into payments and member activity.

What I built

A Spring Boot and Thymeleaf application backed by MySQL, with authentication, validation, reports, PDF receipts, dashboard charts and administrative profiles.

What I learned: Structuring backend logic and relational data around everyday operations.

JavaSpring BootThymeleafMySQLJPA

03 / ANDROID APPLICATION

Smart Tourism

A mobile tourism experience combining discovery, bookings, receipts and device features.

The need

A tourism app needs to connect useful location-based information with a smooth booking flow.

What I built

Customer and admin workflows with Firebase data, PDF booking receipts, biometric verification, compass and location features, plus Stripe sandbox payments.

What I learned: Connecting mobile device capabilities, cloud data and in-app payment flows.

AndroidFirebaseStripe sandboxLocation

04 / COMPUTER VISION

Smart Face Attendance

A prototype for real-time face recognition and liveness detection through a camera.

The need

A face-based attendance flow needs stronger checks than a still image.

What I built

Python, OpenCV and MediaPipe process live input and use blink, head-turn and return-to-center checks based on facial landmarks.

What I learned: Working with real-time camera data and software-to-hardware interactions.

PythonOpenCVMediaPipeComputer vision
